title: Implement operator key generation tool
description:
Implement a CLI tool (transit keygen or a standalone binary) that generates an ed25519 keypair, writes the private key to a PEM file (mode 0600) and the public key to a separate PEM file, and prints the public key fingerprint (SHA256 of the DER-encoded public key, hex). Artifact: transit/src/cli/keygen.rs or tools/keygen/src/main.rs.

Acceptance:
- Generated private key file has mode 0600
- Generated public key file has mode 0644
- Fingerprint printed to stdout matches openssl pkey -pubin -fingerprint output
- --output-dir flag specifies output directory
- Attempting to overwrite existing key files fails with error (--force flag required)
